basic_details.job_title: DDA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Consultant, Young Professional Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) is engaging 3 Young Professionals and 1 Consultant in GIS for its Land Management department, purely on a contractual basis for an initial 01 year. Pay is Rs. 55,000 to Rs. 80,000 a month plus local conveyance, depending on the post. The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Geo-informatics/GIS/Geomatics, or a Master's degree in Geography with a one-year diploma in Remote Sensing and GIS Applications. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 10 December 2026 under Advertisement No. 10/Consultant/2026/Rectt. Cell/Pers./DDA.

qualification.details: Experience in the use of AutoCAD software. Knowledge of using Delhi Revenue Maps for planning, Master Plan, sub-regional plan, land management and other purposes. Experience in drone data processing and management. Working knowledge of satellite imagery, machine learning and deep learning for LULC classification. Proficiency in GIS software/tools such as ArcGIS, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, QGIS, Python, DGPS and working on Total Station data. Working experience in Delhi Government/State Government/Central Government organisations (such as NRSC, ISRO, RRSC, etc.) or autonomous bodies.

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed Format of Application attached to the notice, duly typed, quoting the advertisement number and the post applied for.
Fix a photograph in the space provided and put a specimen signature in the space provided.
Give the educational qualifications starting from class 10th onwards, details of employment, and which desirable skills you hold (Yes/No).
Attach a write-up on how you will perform the task required for the post, as asked in the form.
Scan the signed form as a PDF of size under 5 MB.
Email it to [email protected] on or before 10.12.2026.

Do not enclose any documents with the email. Applications by any other mode, after the last date, or not in the prescribed format will not be entertained. No correspondence by email, post or phone about the application will be entertained.

The application form also asks for category, gender, name, father's/husband's name, date of birth and age as on closing date, address, email ID, contact numbers, any pending court case, any conviction, and a signed declaration.
important_instructions: Original and supporting documents are produced only at the interview, if called. DDA reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter the number of Consultants to be engaged, the terms and conditions, or any other part of the notification and engagement process, if needed, without issuing any notice. Candidates are advised to check the DDA website regularly for updates. For queries, contact Recruitment Cell, Room No. B-11, DDA, Vikas Sadan, INA, New Delhi-110023.

content_sections.heading: DDA Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the place of posting.

rows.details: Young Professional Level II (GIS), Young Professional Level IV (GIS), Consultant Level II (GIS)
Rs. 55,000 + Rs. 1,500 local conveyance (Young Professional Level II); Rs. 70,000 + Rs. 2,000 (Young Professional Level IV); Rs. 80,000 + Rs. 3,000 (Consultant Level II), per month
Email (scanned, signed application form in PDF)

content_sections.heading: About DDA
content_sections.text: The Delhi Development Authority has its office at Vikas Sadan, I.N.A., New Delhi - 110023, and its website is http://www.dda.gov.in . This notice is issued by its Recruitment Cell and signed by the Commissioner (Personnel). The posts are for the Land Management department of DDA.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 3 Young Professionals and 1 Consultant, 4 posts in all, all purely on contractual basis. The notice prints the figure 3 once for the two Young Professional levels together and does not split it between Level II and Level IV. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All three posts carry the same essential qualification: a Master's degree in Geo-informatics/GIS/Geomatics, OR a Master's degree in Geography with a one-year diploma in Remote Sensing and GIS Applications, from a recognized University/Institute. Qualifications, experience and professional qualifications acquired after the closing date of applications will not be considered. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Experience in the use of AutoCAD software. Knowledge of using Delhi Revenue Maps for planning, Master Plan, sub-regional plan, land management and other purposes. Experience in drone data processing and management. Working knowledge of satellite imagery, machine learning and deep learning for LULC classification. Proficiency in GIS software/tools such as ArcGIS, ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, QGIS, Python, DGPS and working on Total Station data. Working experience in Delhi Government/State Government/Central Government organisations (such as NRSC, ISRO, RRSC, etc.) or autonomous bodies. Experience in the use of AutoCAD software. Knowledge of using Delhi Revenue Maps for planning, Master Plan, sub-regional plan, land management and other purposes. Experience in drone data processing and management. Working knowledge of satellite imagery, machine learning and deep learning for LULC classification. Proficiency in GIS software/tools such as ArcGIS, ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, Python, DGPS, PostGIS and GeoServer. At least 5 years of working experience in Delhi Government/State Government/Central Government organisations (such as NRSC, ISRO, RRSC, etc.) or autonomous bodies. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

rows.experience: 2 years or more and less than 5 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Young Professionals and Consultants will be hired for the Land Management department on a fixed consolidated remuneration per month plus local conveyance, as shown in the vacancy table. A 5% annual enhancement on the base rate, that is the proposed remuneration, will apply as per policy. The period of engagement is 01 year for each post. DDA may extend the contract period depending on requirement and satisfactory performance of the candidate, which will be reviewed annually. The posts are temporary and confer no right to permanent employment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DDA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Do not enclose any documents with the email. Applications by any other mode, after the last date, or not in the prescribed format will not be entertained. No correspondence by email, post or phone about the application will be entertained. The application form also asks for category, gender, name, father's/husband's name, date of birth and age as on closing date, address, email ID, contact numbers, any pending court case, any conviction, and a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Sending the form does not mean the applicant will be called for interview. Only candidates shortlisted as per the criteria devised by DDA, keeping in view the requirement of the work, will be called before the interview board. The criteria for selection include the marks obtained in the required essential qualifications, relevant experience and the marks obtained in the interview. The date, time and venue of the interview will be intimated in due course. Candidates called for interview should bring all documents and certificates related to qualification and experience, 02 passport size photographs in original, and one set of self-attested photocopies of the documents supporting educational qualification and experience. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Original and supporting documents are produced only at the interview, if called. DDA reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter the number of Consultants to be engaged, the terms and conditions, or any other part of the notification and engagement process, if needed, without issuing any notice. Candidates are advised to check the DDA website regularly for updates. For queries, contact Recruitment Cell, Room No. B-11, DDA, Vikas Sadan, INA, New Delhi-110023.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in DDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 3 Young Professionals and 1 Consultant, all in the Land Management department of DDA on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 December 2026. The application form must be emailed to [email protected] by that date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the DDA GIS posts?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Geo-informatics/GIS/Geomatics, or a Master's degree in Geography with a one-year diploma in Remote Sensing and GIS Applications, from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age as on the closing date of application is 33 years for Young Professional Level II, 38 years for Young Professional Level IV and 43 years for Consultant Level II.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 55,000 + Rs. 1,500 local conveyance for Young Professional Level II, Rs. 70,000 + Rs. 2,000 for Level IV, and Rs. 80,000 + Rs. 3,000 for Consultant Level II, per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application format with a photograph and signature, scan it as a PDF under 5 MB and email it to [email protected] without enclosing any documents.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: DDA shortlists applicants by its own criteria and calls them for interview. Selection includes marks in the essential qualification, relevant experience and the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is contractual for an initial 01 year, may be extended on requirement and satisfactory performance, and gives no right to permanent employment.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring all qualification and experience documents and certificates, 02 passport size photographs in original, and one set of self-attested photocopies of the supporting documents.
